'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]] says that it has captured the village of [[Pisky, Pokrovsk Raion|Pisky]], in [[Donetsk Oblast]], while [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] say that they have destroyed a bridge in [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Russian-occupied]] [[Kherson Oblast]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-fires-donetsk-ef079e9648ceb5dab4a4fd3bc0954406 (AP)]
**[[Russian occupation of Mykolaiv Oblast]]
***Establishment of pro-Russian [[Governor of Mykolaiv Oblast|Mykolaiv military–civilian administration]] with seat in [[Snihurivka]] is announced, {{ill|Yuri Barbashov|pl|Jurij Barbaszow}} becomes its head. It probably began functioning some days earlier. [https://360tv.ru/news/ukrainian-crisis/snigirevka-nikolaevskoj-oblasti-primet-uchastie-v-referendume-o-prisoedinenii-k-rossii/ (360tv.ru)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Pacific typhoon season]]
**Tropical Storm Meari makes landfall in [[central Japan]], causing heavy rain and high winds. 72,000 people are evacuated from the city of [[Shizuoka, Shizuoka|Shizuoka]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-08-13/tropical-storm-meari-hammers-japan-with-heavy-rainfall-wind (Bloomberg News)]
*[[2022 Oder environmental disaster]]
**The [[Federal Ministry for the Environment, Nature Conservation, Nuclear Safety and Consumer Protection|German environment ministry]] says that an unknown, highly toxic substance is responsible for the [[mass mortality event|mass die-off]] of [[wildlife]] in the [[Oder]] river. High levels of [[mercury (element)|mercury]] have also been found in the river. [[Polish Prime Minister]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] says that the river will take years to "return to normal". [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/08/13/europe/mass-fish-death-poland-germany-river-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*One person is killed and 40 others are injured when a stage at a music festival in [[Cullera]], Valencia, Spain, collapses due to high winds caused by a nearby [[heat burst]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/one-killed-17-injured-stage-collapse-spanish-festival-2022-08-13/ (Reuters)] [https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20220813/reventon-calido-fenomeno-atmosferico-llevado-tragedia-medusa-festival/2396324.shtml (RTVE)]
*Flooding in [[Las Vegas]], Nevada, United States, kills two people and also damages [[The Linq]] hotel. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/las-vegas-monsoon-flooding-deaths-casino-damage/ (CBS News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Treatment of women by the Taliban]]
**The [[Taliban]] violently disperse a [[political demonstration|demonstration]] by [[women's rights]] activists who were marching to the education ministry in [[Kabul]] to demand broader [[human rights in Afghanistan|rights]], by chasing and beating women and firing gunshots into the air. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/13/taliban-disperse-rare-womens-protest-in-kabul (Al Jazeera)]
*One person is killed and 17 others are injured after a driver [[vehicle-ramming attack|plows his car]] into a fundraiser for victims of a house fire that killed ten people earlier in [[Nescopeck, Pennsylvania|Nescopeck]], [[Pennsylvania]], United States. The perpetrator then kills his mother in a nearby town before being arrested. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/08/14/us/pennsylvania-crash-fire-fundraiser.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Sports'''
*Romanian swimmer [[David Popovici]] breaks the 13-year-old world record for the 100m freestyle with a time of 46.86. [https://swimswam.com/watch-david-popovici-becomes-4th-swimmer-under-47-seconds-in-100m-free/ (SwimSwam)]
